claims.claim: A strong neatly used kids bicycle
claims.evidence: Witness confirms it is a bicycle with a blue seat and indoor storage, but wheel/frame size and whether it is specifically a kids model are not shown.
No receipt/date, serial number, or documentation shown/readable.
Witness notes no clear readable gear/shifter/derailleur details and does not report brake performance or brake pad/cable condition.
Witness does not report rust status; frame/component condition is not described beyond lack of readable text.
No close-up of component markings/serials or confirmation of originality is provided.

risks.risk: Unknown gear type and drivetrain condition (single-speed vs multi-gear; derailleur/shifter issues not visible).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo/video of the drivetrain and shifters/derailleurs (both sides), plus a short clip showing gear changes under pedaling.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a basic used kids bicycle with unknown drivetrain condition (assume possible gear issues).

risks.risk: Brakes may not be perfect (pad/shoe wear, cable stretch, brake alignment).
risks.proof: A short video clip of braking from a slow roll (front and rear), showing the bike stopping smoothly, plus close-ups of brake pads/shoes and cables.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing brake service/adjustment (assume reduced braking performance).

risks.risk: Tire condition and whether tires hold air (tread wear, punctures, sidewall cracks).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires (tread and sidewalls) and a clip showing the bike after a short ride or a quick pressure check if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tires may be worn/possibly needing replacement.

risks.risk: Wheel/rim and bearing condition (alignment, rim dents, bearing play).
risks.proof: A clip showing wheel spin and side-to-side wobble check, plus close-ups of rims for dents and spokes for looseness.
risks.if_unproven: Price as wheels/bearings may need adjustment or minor repair.

risks.risk: Frame/component hidden damage (rust, cracks, dents) and missing/replaced parts.
risks.proof: Full-frame walkaround photos (both sides) in good light, including joints and underside, and close-ups of chain guard, rack mounts, and fork.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible cosmetic/structural wear with unknown integrity.

risks.risk: Size/spec uncertainty (wheel size/frame size) affects buyer fit and resale value.
risks.proof: Photo of wheel size marking (if any) and a measurement shot (rim diameter or frame size), plus a standing-over/fit photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic kids bicycle with unknown size.

risks.risk: Accessories and functionality (lights working, lock/pump/bell included).
risks.proof: A clip showing the headlight turning on and working, and photos of any included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming extra accessories beyond what is clearly shown.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the gear system (shifters/derailleurs or single-speed sprocket) and a short video showing gear changes while pedaling.
Video of braking from a slow roll (front and rear) plus close-ups of brake pads/shoes and brake cables.
Close-up photos of both tires (tread + sidewalls) and confirmation they hold air (or a pressure check).
Wheel condition check: video of wheel spin for wobble and close-ups of rims/spokes for dents/looseness.
Full-frame photos in good light (both sides, fork, underside) to confirm no cracks/rust and that all parts are original.
Wheel/frame size confirmation: measurement shot or wheel size marking, and a fit/standing-over photo.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies it as a bicycle and describes several visible features (front suspension fork, fender(s), chain guard, rear rack, headlight), but key condition/function details are not verifiable from the report. It can still be priced at a worst-case used level for an unknown-gear, unknown-brake, unknown-tire-condition kids bicycle until the requested proof is provided.
